learningGoals: Understand the concept of making equal groups. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
Learn how to share items equally among friends or family. 🍰
Practice skip counting to build a foundation for multiplication. 🔢
Recognize patterns in numbers when grouping things together. 🧩
teachingTips: Use snacks like grapes or biscuits to demonstrate sharing equally among family members. 🍇
When putting away toys, ask them to make equal groups (e.g., piles of 3 blocks each). 🧱
Practice counting by 2s or 5s while walking up the stairs or jumping. 🏃‍♂️
Always emphasize the word 'equal' so they understand everyone gets the same amount. ⚖️

funActivities.title: Biscuit Sharing 🍪
funActivities.description: Give your child 12 biscuits and ask them to share them equally between 3 plates.

funActivities.title: Sock Pairs 🧦
funActivities.description: While folding laundry, have them count the total number of socks by counting in groups of two.

funActivities.title: Toy Teams 🧸
funActivities.description: Ask them to group their favorite action figures or dolls into teams of exactly four members.
